name: inventory: what a unit carries, what it weighs, and where it runs out

steps.note: a human, paused so nothing it does changes what it is holding while this test reads it
it starts with nothing: empty hand, nothing stowed, no weight
giving goes on the simulation's own command queue - the spawn pass carries it out, and that pass runs every fixed step even while the world is paused
two kinds at once, each counted on its own

steps.shot: 2 food and 3 water, with the two totals under them

steps.note: food is bulky for its weight, so it is SPACE that runs out: 12 litres, less the 1.5 the three waters take, leaves room for 8 more food and no more - 10 in all, and the other 12 asked for are refused

steps.shot: full: space ran out before weight did

steps.note: and a refusal is not a reset - what would not fit is simply not there, and everything else is where it was
the debug menu shows the same facts from the simulation's own side

steps.shot: holding, carrying and load in the debug menu

steps.note: nobody selected, nobody to give to: the step says so rather than guessing
